items.statement: The submission constructs and analyzes WT MnKstD2 and the single A395G variant with the same explicitly disclosed system definition, atom mapping, and comparable sampling/analysis treatment.
items.expected: Both named states are present; mapping for C1_sub, C2_sub, O3_sub, N5_FAD, OH_Y359 and OH_Y532 is explicit; matched-treatment and convergence evidence are reported.

items.statement: A395G is associated with a more catalytically competent 4-PG/FAD geometry than WT.
items.expected: Relative to WT, A395G shows shorter or more favorable C1_sub–N5_FAD and C2_sub–OH_Y359 distances and a higher productive-frame fraction, within the submitted definitions.

items.statement: The mutation strengthens the substrate interaction network and does not show greater global structural fluctuation than WT in the reported analysis.
items.expected: A395G has higher OH_Y532–O3_sub hydrogen-bond occupancy and reduced or no worse backbone fluctuation than WT, with limitations stated.
